changelog:

- Drafts audit-ready ESG disclosure sections in CSRD/ESRS style, adaptable to other frameworks.
- Outputs include double-materiality framing, a metric-methodology-limitation triplet table, explicit forward-looking statements with basis, and honest data-gap handling.

- Clearly distinguishes between what is fact, ambition, and what still needs to be confirmed.
